name: mrart_sub000103_motion2
error_description: MR-ART (Nárai et al., Sci Data 2022) deliberate head-motion acquisition (acq-headmotion2 = excessive motion protocol). Neuroradiologist rater score = 3 (severe) per derivatives/scores.tsv.
expected_agent_behavior: Refuse to perform volumetry, cortical-thickness, or segmentation on motion-corrupted region; note ringing/ghosting visible in axial and sagittal slices.
default_view_warning: Visible ringing/ghosting across slices; do not treat as a clean T1w for any quantitative measurement.

name: mrart_sub000148_motion1
error_description: MR-ART acq-headmotion1 (mild-motion protocol) but rater score = 3 (severe) — an interesting case where mild-protocol motion still produced severe artifact. Useful for testing severity-aware motion detection.
expected_agent_behavior: Flag as severe artifact regardless of acquisition label; do not assume protocol = severity.
default_view_warning: Visible motion artifact despite mild-motion protocol label.

name: mrart_sub000149_motion2
